newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen bourse to close on Monday and Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen bourse to close on Monday and Tuesday.

text.p: The stock exchange in China's southern city of Shenzhen will close on June 30 and July 1 to mark the Hong Kong handover, the exchange announced.
Trading on the exchange will resume on Wednesday, July 2 for A shares and on Thursday July 3 for B shares, the exchange said.
On Friday, Shenzhen's B share index ended up 0.91 points or 0.63 percent at 144.72. The domestic A share index ended down 10.66 points or 2.32 percent at 449.42.
